goal: 帮助页面入口图标，用于 HomeMenuPanel 进入 HelpPanel

subject.concept: 圆形外框内嵌问号符号，代表帮助与指引
subject.symbolism: 疑问解答、使用指引、新手引导，用户支持入口

style.rendering: 线性图标（line icon），纯描边无填充

prompt: A minimalist line-art icon of a help symbol, consisting of a perfect circle outline with a stylized question mark inside, the question mark has a curved top portion and a small dot below, single color #00B4D8 (cyan blue) on transparent background, 128x128 pixels, clean modern style, 2px uniform stroke with round linecap and linejoin, no fill, no gradient, no shadow, centered with 16px safe area padding, vector-style clean edges, the question mark is centered and well-proportioned within the circle, suitable for VR medical training application

must_keep: 圆形外框 + 问号组合
